comparison.permissions: read-only sandbox; advisory task; no writes or external actions

review_method: Independent AI reviewer, blinded A/B per-case mapping; exact inherited reviewer model not instrumented. Controller unblinded. No human behavioral sign-off.
limitations: Explicitly activated read-only advisory tasks; no rendered app, integration, or live-account validation. Published assertions preserved; unperformed checks remain not_run. Public extracts contain synthetic output plus controller metadata; raw streams retained privately. AI judgments are not authenticated execution or approval. Effective tools were not exhaustively serialized; matching declared runtime/configuration is not independent attestation of identical service-side tools.
